description: This file defines a PHP controller class for managing geographical zones (geo zones) within the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, and deleting geo zones, as well as generating URLs, handling permissions, and rendering views.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Controller class for CRUD operations related to Geo Zones in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main page with the list of geo zones.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the list view of geo zones.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the list of geo zones with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a geo zone.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated geo zone data, including validation and permission checks.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected geo zones after permission validation and checks for related tax rates.
